entries.name: highway-adr
entries.description: Records one architecture decision for one discovery. Use when a discovery's options are ready and the person wants to choose one and record it as an ADR, or when highway-onboarding hands off a provider decision.
entries.usage: Run highway-adr with one discovery id.

entries.name: highway-architecture
entries.description: Manages one reference architecture from one accepted adr. Use when an ADR is accepted and the person wants the reference architecture that realizes it, or when highway-onboarding hands off an accepted ADR.
entries.usage: Run highway-architecture with one adr id.

entries.name: highway-assessment
entries.description: Assesses accepted repository context. Use when the person wants to see how the accepted architectures, implementations, or whole portfolio stand.

entries.name: highway-codify-config
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide guidance used by highway-codify. Use when the person wants to set up or update the platforms highway-codify writes for, or when another highway skill directs the person here.
entries.usage: Run highway-codify-config, or with one implementation name.

entries.name: highway-codify
entries.description: Manages one functional artifact for one accepted implementation. Use when the person wants working code for an accepted reference implementation, or wants to see the code catalog and discuss one automation.
entries.usage: Run highway-codify with one implementation name.

entries.name: highway-controls
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide control baseline. Use when highway-setup delegates the control baseline, after Objectives finish or when setup runs again.

entries.name: highway-discovery
entries.description: Manages one discovery for a complete request. Use when a request is complete and the person wants to explore options for it, or wants to resume an existing discovery.
entries.usage: Run highway-discovery with one request id or one discovery id.

entries.name: highway-experience
entries.description: Holds highway identity, the experience standard, and the storage contract. Use when another highway skill loads it as its first step, or when the person asks what highway is. Not for a request unrelated to highway.
entries.usage: Loaded by every other highway skill. Run highway-experience directly for a summary of highway.

entries.name: highway-help
entries.description: Prints registration details for one named skill, or a discovery listing of every registered skill when none is named. Use when the person wants to confirm a skill exists or find how to run it.
entries.usage: Run highway-help for all skills, or highway-help <skill-id> for one named skill's registration details.

entries.name: highway-implementation
entries.description: Manages one reference implementation from one accepted reference architecture. Use when a reference architecture is accepted and the person wants the implementation that realizes it, or when another highway skill hands one off.
entries.usage: Run highway-implementation with one architecture id.

entries.name: highway-nfrs
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide nfr baseline. Use when highway-setup delegates the nfr baseline, after Controls finish or when setup runs again.

entries.name: highway-objectives
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide business objective baseline and its stable traceability references. Use when highway-setup delegates the objective baseline, after Profile finishes or when setup runs again.

entries.name: highway-onboarding
entries.description: Manages one decision, one reference architecture, and one reference implementation. Use when the person wants to onboard one capability in a single pass, grounded in accepted setup or architecture records.

entries.name: highway-profile
entries.description: Manages the repository-wide organizational Profile and its contextual guidance. Use when highway-setup delegates the Profile, at the start of setup or when setup runs again.

entries.name: highway-request
entries.description: Manages one business request and its accepted artifact. Use when the person has a business problem, idea, or desired change to record as a request.
entries.usage: Run highway-request with the business change.
entries.example: /highway-request We need a consistent way for finance reviewers to reduce manual invoice comparison time.

entries.name: highway-setup
entries.description: Orchestrates initial highway setup through the owning governance skills. Use when the person sets up highway in a repository for the first time, or runs setup again to revise it.
